name: Little Pamela
label: Quest
description: Little Pamela: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So many of us died at the battle of Darrowshire. So many died... And worse.
When the battle began I hid my niece Pamela, and I do not know what happened to her. I am but a wandering spirit, but my heart still longs to know Pamela's fate.
Please, good adventurer. Will you go to Darrowshire and search for her? It is to the east, beyond Gahrron's Withering.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello. I'm Pamela, what's your name?
